claim: The shift a glass half-space (eps_sub = 2.25, 50 nm gap) imposes on the split +-n whispering-gallery QNM pair of an n_core = 3.0, rad = 100 nm circle agrees with MEEP, an FDTD ringdown fitted by harminv that shares no equation, discretisation or contour with pysie2d's Beyn search over the Sommerfeld operator.
driver_args: --df-frac 0.2 --src=0.62,0.48 --probe=-0.55,0.6 --until 400 --resolution 100 --parity {+1,-1}; one parity per run, so harminv fits one pole

tolerance.justification: Compared quantity is the substrate-induced shift lambda(2.25) - lambda(1.0), each code against itself, which cancels MEEP's grid error (0.019 nm TE, 0.094 nm TM at resolution 100) to first order. Measured |delta shift| at resolutions 64/80/100: even poles 8e-5 to 1.2e-3 nm and converging; odd poles 2.2e-3 to 4.7e-3 nm, flat in resolution, a MEEP-side floor. 1e-2 nm is ~2x the worst, against shifts of 0.4-1.4 nm.

convergence: Absolute |delta lambda| vs pysie2d falls 0.30 -> 0.019 nm (TE) and 0.58 -> 0.094 nm (TM) over resolution 25 -> 100, identically with and without the substrate; PML 2-8 a and padding 1.5-6 a move nothing at 1e-3 nm.
